create_llm_engine_token_in_token_out: create an sglang Engine with skip_tokenizer_init=True to accept tokenized input ids instead of text prompts
run_generate_tokenized_inputs: run llm.generate with pre-encoded token ids and sampling params to produce decoded text outputs
test_tokenizer_encode_decode: test get_tokenizer to encode text prompts into token ids and decode generated token ids back to text
build_sampling_params: build sampling parameters with temperature and top_p for controlled text generation
summarize_token_in_token_out_workflow: summarize the token-in-token-out workflow where tokenized ids are passed directly to the LLM engine
